scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: तू केव्हा येणार आहेस? [When are you coming?]
Character B says: I will return back on Monday. [I will return back on Monday.]
Character A says: Return back नाही। Return म्हणजेच परत येणं। Return आणि back दोन्ही एकत्र म्हणजे परत परत का येतोयस। Just say I will return on Monday। [Not return back. Return means to come back. Return and back together means why are you coming back again and again. Just say I will return on Monday.]
Character B says: Ohh... ठीक आहे ठीक आहे। मला ना English येतच नाही। [Ohh... okay okay. I don't know English at all.]
Character A says: काही problem नाही। AI teachers try केलं का? [No problem. Have you tried AI teachers?]
Character B says: ते महाग असतील ना? [They must be expensive, right?]
Character A says: अजिबात नाही। Normal English classes पेक्षा 7 पट स्वस्त आहे। [Not at all. It is 7 times cheaper than normal English classes.]
